annotations.title: Get an X AI Assistant Chat Job Result

description: Reads a Grok chat job by the job_id its submit call returned. While the job runs: 202 with status 'pending', poll_after_seconds and created_at. When it finishes: 200 with the full Grok chat reply (answer, citations, tool_calls, conversation and turn ids, requested and actual model) plus job_id and status 'done'. When the chat failed: the status and typed error the buffered call would have answered, plus job_id and status 'failed'; 504 job_timeout and 503 job_interrupted mean the job did not finish on this API's side. An unknown job_id, a finished answer older than 15 minutes and another API key's job all answer 404. The $0.004 Grok chat price is charged once, on the first poll that delivers the finished answer; polling it again is free. Needs only the API key that submitted the job, no X session. Cost: Free per call. Docs: https://docs.twitterapis.com/docs/reference/grok/grok-chat-result

fields.description: Optional. Comma-separated dotted field paths to keep in the response, applied to every object in the returned lists and to nested objects (e.g. "id,text,author.username"; a list name may prefix a path, "tweets.id"; a prefix that lands on an array applies to each element). Pagination and envelope keys (next_cursor, cursor, has_more, count, partial, error, message, reason) are kept regardless; every other top-level key not named is dropped.

job_id.description: The job_id the submit call returned, a UUID.
